02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Product thinking.
Visual instinct.

I'm Deepak Sharma, a product designer and vibe coder based in Greater Noida, India. I specialize in UI/UX and interaction design, with a foundation in visual design and AI-assisted product development.

I design responsive web and mobile experiences, from research, information architecture, and wireframes to design systems and high-fidelity prototypes. AI-assisted tools help me turn ideas into functional experiences and explore possibilities quickly.
